proof_scope: Frozen new EC mains are freshly compiled with own semantic EOF controls. Imported EC and prior Coq sources are linked to the preceding adaptive-history full PASS. call_scope: Typed/full raw H responses are recorded through the concrete list store before prefix return, including valid zero-length requests; internal G goes through the supplied O.g. Final attacker transcripts erase unused legacy H-map state and do not execute the old SimLookup.
not_claimed: fresh local state obtained by aliasing old globals
import_axiom_scope: Imported proof contexts retain their reviewed scope. No new local axiom, final distance assumption, admit, native Coq invocation or checker-disable pragma is permitted. Generic store contracts must be discharged by the final concrete local store.

prior_evidence.scope: hash-linked prior result; no fresh replay

lemma rt_original_runtime_bound:
  forall (A(H : CCAExtendedOraclePort, D : CCADecapPort) <:
           CCAExtendedAdversary{-ROE, -ROF, -ROG, -ROH, -FOContext, -FOBadState, -FOBudgetState, -RawXOFStreams, -CCADecapOracle, -FOGRO.RO, -FOGRO.FRO, -FOPublicKey, -SimPublic, -SimHistory, -SimBad, -SimHRO.RO, -SimHRO.FRO, -SimGRO.RO, -SimGRO.FRO, -SimPhaseInput, -SimSelectedFixed, -SH.HB.Count, -SH.HB.HybOrcl, -SimPublicBudget, -ErasureSeedLog, -ErasureHit, -ErasureSeedPool, -EBudgetState, -ErasureTape, -CPAReduction, -CPAHitState, -SecGHistory, -SecGMark}),
    exists (DI DO <: RTWordNTRUMeasured) (CO <: RTWordRLWEMeasured),
      (forall (p0 : NTRUPlus768CyclotomicFactorization.NTRUPoly.poly)
         (tA : int),
         0 <= tA =>
         hoare[ DI.measure :
                 arg = ow_coeff_words p0 ==>
                 rt_complete_di_charge tA res.`2 res.`3 <=
                 rt_complete_di_bound tA res.`2.`rp_q res.`2.`rp_b ]) /\
      (forall (p0 : NTRUPlus768CyclotomicFactorization.NTRUPoly.poly)
         (tA : int),
         0 <= tA =>
         hoare[ DO.measure :
                 arg = ow_coeff_words p0 ==>
                 rt_complete_do_charge tA res.`2 res.`3 <=
                 rt_complete_do_bound tA res.`2.`rp_q res.`2.`rp_b ]) /\
      (forall (p0 q0 : NTRUPlus768CyclotomicFactorization.NTRUPoly.poly)
         (tA : int),
         0 <= tA =>
         hoare[ CO.measure :
                 a = ow_coeff_words p0 /\ b = ow_coeff_words q0 ==>
                 rt_complete_co_charge tA res.`2 res.`3 <=
                 rt_complete_co_bound tA res.`2.`rp_q res.`2.`rp_b ]) /\
      equiv[ DI.run  ~ DI.measure :
              arg{1} = arg{2} /\ (glob DI){1} = (glob DI){2} ==>
              res{1} = res{2}.`1] /\
      equiv[ DO.run  ~ DO.measure :
              arg{1} = arg{2} /\ (glob DO){1} = (glob DO){2} ==>
              res{1} = res{2}.`1] /\
      equiv[ CO.run  ~ CO.measure :
              arg{1} = arg{2} /\ (glob CO){1} = (glob CO){2} ==>
              res{1} = res{2}.`1] /\
      forall &m (qE q0 qH qC : int),
        0 <= q0 =>
        FOBudgetState.limit{m} = q0 =>
        0 <= qH =>
        0 <= qC =>
        (forall (H <: CCAExtendedOraclePort{-A}) (D <: CCADecapPort{-A}),
           islossless H.e =>
           islossless H.f =>
           islossless H.g =>
           islossless H.h =>
           islossless H.raw => islossless D.decap => islossless A(H, D).guess) =>
        hoare[ CountedA(A, SharedCCAExtendedOracles, CCADecapOracle).guess :
                EBudgetState.requests = 0 /\
                EBudgetState.forwarded = 0 /\
                EBudgetState.limit = qE /\
                !EBudgetState.overflow /\ EBudgetState.queries = [] ==>
                EBudgetState.requests <= qE ] =>
        erasure_budget_initial qE EBudgetState.requests{m}
          EBudgetState.forwarded{m} EBudgetState.limit{m}
          EBudgetState.overflow{m} EBudgetState.queries{m} =>
        hoare[
                FOCountedA(A, FOHashView(FONativePlainBackend),
                  FODecapView(FONativePlainBackend)).guess :
                fo_budget_initial q0 FOBudgetState.nH FOBudgetState.nD
                  FOBudgetState.limit FOBudgetState.overflow ==>
                fo_query_count FOBudgetState.nH FOBudgetState.nD <= q0 ] =>
        hoare[
                FOCountedA(A, FOHashView(FOFullPlainBackend),
                  FODecapView(FOFullPlainBackend)).guess :
                fo_budget_initial q0 FOBudgetState.nH FOBudgetState.nD
                  FOBudgetState.limit FOBudgetState.overflow ==>
                fo_query_count FOBudgetState.nH FOBudgetState.nD <= q0 ] =>
        (forall (H <: CCAExtendedOraclePort{-FOBudgetState, -A})
           (D <: CCADecapPort{-FOBudgetState, -A}),
           hoare[ FOCountedA(A, H, D).guess :
                   FOBudgetState.nD = 0 ==> FOBudgetState.nD <= max 0 budget ]) =>
        hoare[
                SimPublicCountedA(A, FOHashView(SimKnownPublicBackend),
                  FODecapView(SimKnownPublicBackend)).guess :
                sim_public_budget_initial qH SimPublicBudget.nh
                  SimPublicBudget.limit SimPublicBudget.overflow ==>
                SimPublicBudget.nh <= qH ] =>
        hoare[ CPAPhase(A).run : true ==> fsize SimHistory.h <= qC ] =>
        `|Pr[CCAOriginalGame(A).run() @ &m : res] - 1%r / 2%r| <=
        (130820%r + 512%r * qE%r) / 2%r ^ 256 + q0%r / 2%r ^ 353 +
        ((max 0 budget)%r / 2%r ^ 768 + (qH + max 0 budget)%r / 2%r ^ 353) +
        (2%r *
         ((Pr[RTWordNTRURealGame(DI).run() @ &m : res] -
           Pr[RTWordNTRUUniformGame(DI).run() @ &m : res] + 1%r / 2%r ^ 244) /
          ow_alpha_g +
          (Pr[RTWordNTRURealGame(DO).run() @ &m : res] -
           Pr[RTWordNTRUUniformGame(DO).run() @ &m : res] +
           Pr[RTWordRLWEGame(CO).run() @ &m : res]) /
          ow_alpha_g) +
         qC%r / 2%r ^ 768) +
        2%r * (qC%r / 2%r ^ 353).

manual.scope: Ten explicit word-scan/sampling templates; full kernel-composition coverage is checked separately.

sim.backend_cost: separate actual G.get result; must be closed by phase calibration

phase.scope: Owned fixed arrays, persistent lists, unit integer control, explicit ideal ROM; ledger observations erased.

outer.attacker_self: only t_A, one actual invocation; no whole-reduction time premise
outer.scope: actual run includes the independently priced dispatcher plus its measured core exactly once
outer.source_calibration: typed source + complete AST + independently computed fees and recursive callgraph

composition.scope: Actual callback/history/kernel counts and their concrete total charge; no arbitrary price replacement.

executable_audit.scope: Unit-cost integer/word operations and ideal-ROM primitives; not native CPU, bit complexity, CT/SCT, or a general PPT theorem.

mutation_controls.scope: Source-rule negative controls only; not a proof replay or machine-cost result.

finite_domain_diagnostics.scope: Finite raw length/tag diagnostics only; no adaptive, bit-cost, CPU or PPT claim.
